raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "encexp" %}
{% set version = "0.1.9" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/encexp-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9e5cbb0ac6a17a1222c05887eb4a5ff786d914f8800f8b3a6ffded5696088efd

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=61.0
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    - scikit-learn >=1.3.0
    - microtc

test:
  imports:
    - encexp
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://pypi.org/project/EncExp
  summary: Set of tools to create and use explainable embeddings.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mgraffg
